title: A stable and efficient Galerkin spectral method with asymmetrically-weighted Hermite functions for the Vlasov-Poisson system
summary: We analyze a Galerkin spectral method applied to the Vlasov-Poisson (VP) system based on time-independent asymmetrically-weighted (AW) Hermite functions in velocity. The VP system is written as an hyperbolic system using AW Hermite functions in velocity. Unlike the classical Petrov-Galerkin spectral method, which is not stable, the proposed Galerkin spectral method admits a natural stability in the unweighted L2 norm.
